summary: Bread Financial Holdings filed an 8-K to report the establishment of a new series of preferred stock (8.875% Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B) via a Certificate of Designations, and the issuance of 5,400,000 depositary shares (each representing a 1/40th interest in a share of Series B preferred) at a $1,000 per share liquidation preference. The filing documents the terms, restrictions on dividends/repurchases if Series B dividends are unpaid, and the underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley, RBC, UBS, Wells Fargo, and Keefe Bruyette Woods. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation event. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements are present; the filing is a standard shelf takedown of preferred equity.
